name: project-progress
description: Skill and pane: track long project work in PROGRESS.md: one item at a time with a plan, park side ideas instead of chasing them, checkpoint before /clear; a Progress pane shows where you are

showPane.title: Show the Progress pane
showPane.description: Open the Progress pane when a session starts in a project that has PROGRESS.md. Off: it stays hidden until /progress shows it.

statusLine.title: Show progress in the status line
statusLine.description: Show the current focus and how many Next items are left in the status line. Off by default, since the pane shows the same.
